items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Albert Giles or either Lionel Tarraganda or either Nolan Williams.

ctx.x: I got one, okay. Yeah, I stayed with Morgan five years. And you told us he was in the band? I'm trying to remember, I think you did.
Yeah, I said we had Cleo, I forgot Cleo was writing then. Albert Giles or either Lionel Tarraganda or either Nolan Williams. Or that's another drummer you never heard of him.
Yeah, John, I heard of him.
